Every `moonrush-cli` command, as version 0.8.1 prints it. Run any of them with `--help` for the same text.

## moonrush-cli

```text
moonrush-cli <command> [options]

  config                 Show credentials, or set them by hand
  token <sub>            Token detail, search, and the Verified roster
  market <sub>           Discovery boards and the live fee config
  wallet <sub>           Balances, portfolio, deposits, chart, activity
  send <sub>             Cash out USDC, or move an EVM asset out. MOVES MONEY.
  positions <sub>        Trades: public, your own, top, per token
  leaderboard <metric>   PnL rankings over 24h / 7d / 30d / all time
  rewards <sub>          Creator earnings, and claiming them
  trade <sub>            Quote, buy and sell. MOVES MONEY.
  orders <sub>           Limit, take-profit, stop-loss and trailing orders
  paper <sub>            Play money per API key: real quotes, nothing moved, for testing an agent
  feed <sub>             Mooncalls, reposts and trades from everyone or who you follow
  mooncall <sub>         Read a position's thread, or post on it (publishes)
  follow <sub>           Follow, unfollow, and list follows
  agent <sub>            The hosted trading agent: its trader pool, signals, and yours

Run a command with --help for its sub-commands.
Every command prints JSON on stdout and takes --raw for one line. Errors go to
stderr and exit 1.

No API key yet? Run: moonrush-cli config

These three work with no token at all, so you can check the CLI reaches the API:
  moonrush-cli market config
  moonrush-cli token verified
  moonrush-cli token check --address <addr>
```

## config

```text
Moonrush authenticates with an API KEY, made at
https://moonrush.space/ai/keys. There is no browser sign-in here: that kept a long-lived
credential to a whole account in a file, and a key is scoped, revocable from that page, and
signed by a private half that never leaves this machine.

  moonrush-cli config --generate-key                  # keypair, private half stays here
  # paste the PUBLIC key at https://moonrush.space/ai/keys
  moonrush-cli config --apply-key <key id>.<secret>

Keys have three tiers. `read` is public market data and needs only the key id. Anything that
is one person's (wallet, positions, earnings, trading) needs "Trading and private data" on the
key AND the signing keypair above. Sending money to another address (`send`, perps
withdrawals) needs "Sending money out" as well, off unless you tick it.

Current:
  api      https://social.moonrush.space
  gateway  https://ai.moonrush.space
  api key  set (33af233f82504af4b4df6e75ec9021ec…)
  signing  /Users/hoangkimduc/.config/moonrush/signing-key.pem
```

## token

```text
moonrush-cli token <sub> [options]

  info       --address <addr> [--networkId <id>]   Full detail: stats, risk, top holders
  search     --q <phrase> [--networkId <id|csv>]   Find a token by name or symbol
  verified   [--networkId <id|csv>]                The curated Verified roster (no token needed)
  check      --address <addr> [--networkId <id>]   Is one address Verified (no token needed)
  chart      --address <addr> [--interval 1h] [--bars 100] [--analyze]
                                                 Price candles and a summary; --analyze adds
                                                 swing levels, trend, volume, last-candle shape
  risk       --address <addr> [--refresh]          The risk report: warnings, authorities, holder concentration
  holders    --address <addr> [--cursor <c>]       Every holder, largest first, 50 a page, with share of supply
  dev        --address <addr> [--limit 25]         Who created the token, and everything they launched before

--networkId takes an id or a name: solana (default), robinhood, base, bnb, soneium, arc.
--interval: 15s 30s 1m 5m 15m 30m 1h 4h 12h 1d 1w. --bars: 1 to 1500.
```

## market

```text
moonrush-cli market <sub> [options]

  board      [--networkId <id|csv>]   Verified, Trending, Movers and New in one call
  config                              Live fee and limit config (no token needed)

networkId accepts a comma-separated list to span chains in one board.
Omit it for Solana.
```

## wallet

```text
moonrush-cli wallet <sub> [options]

  balances    [--sol <addr>] [--evm <addr>] [--refresh]   Every chain, one call
  portfolio   [--sol] [--evm] [--sortBy <field>] [--refresh]
                                                          Holdings with PnL
  deposits                                                Active deposit addresses
  chart       --address <addr> [--timeRange <r>] [--unified]
                                                          Portfolio value over time
  activity    --userId <uuid> [--type <t>] [--limit <n>] [--cursor <n>]
                                                          One person, every chain
  stats       --address <addr> [--networkId <id|name>]   ANY wallet's trading record:
                                                          win rate, realised PnL, volume, 1d/7d/30d/1y
  created     --address <addr> --networkId <id|name> [--limit 25]
                                                          Tokens an address launched, and how they did

--sortBy: valueUsd (default), pnlUsd, pnlPercent
--timeRange: 24h (default), 7d, 30d, all
--type: all (default), trades, transfers, cash
```

## send

```text
moonrush-cli send <sub> [options]

  usdc    --to <address> --amount <n> [--networkId <id|name>] [--note <text>]
          Cash out Solana USDC. Same chain by default; any other chain BRIDGES.
  asset   --token <native|0x…> --amount <minor|max> --to <0x…> [--networkId <id|name>]
          Move an EVM asset out of the embedded wallet. Same chain, no bridge.

Both MOVE MONEY and cannot be recalled. Each shows the exact figures and asks on a
terminal; --yes is for a person typing on their own machine.

Destination chains for `usdc`: solana (default, plain SPL transfer), base, bnb,
robinhood (delivers USDG, there is no USDC there), soneium (USDC.e), arc.
Bridged withdrawals have a 5 USDC minimum.
```

## positions

```text
moonrush-cli positions <sub> [options]

  list     [--userId <uuid>] [--tokenAddress <addr>] [--status <s>]
           [--sortBy <f>] [--limit <n>] [--cursor <c>]     Public trades
  me       [--status <s>] [--sortBy <f>] [--limit <n>] [--cursor <c>]
                                                           Your own trades
  top      [--sortBy <f>] [--limit <n>]                    Best open trades
  smart    [--metric pnl7d] [--top 10]                     What the leaderboard's top traders hold now,
                                                           by how many of them hold each token
  stats    --tokenAddress <addr> [--networkId <id>]        Who is holding one token

--status: OPEN, CLOSED
--sortBy on list/me: openedAt (default), currentBalanceUsd, totalPnlUsd
--sortBy on top:     totalPnlUsd (default), currentBalanceUsd
```

## leaderboard

```text
moonrush-cli leaderboard <metric> [options]

  <metric>   pnl24h | pnl7d | pnl30d | pnlAll

  --rank                 Your own rank on that metric, instead of the list
  --around               The rows either side of you, instead of the top
  --page <n>             1-based (default 1). Not a cursor: this endpoint pages.
  --limit <n>            1 to 100 (default 50; 10 with --around)
```

## rewards

```text
moonrush-cli rewards <sub> [options]

  me        What you have earned from other people's trades
  claim     Send yourself what is past its hold. MOVES MONEY.

claim asks for confirmation on a terminal and refuses without one.
--yes skips the question and is for a person to type, never an agent.
```

## trade

```text
moonrush-cli trade <sub> [options]

  quote    What a buy or sell would get, without trading
  buy      Spend USDC on a token. MOVES MONEY.
  sell     Sell a token for USDC. MOVES MONEY.

  --address <token>         The token (required)
  --networkId <id|name>     solana (default), robinhood, base, bnb, soneium, arc
  --side buy|sell           quote only
  --usd <n>                 buy: dollars to spend (EVM minimum $5)
  --percent <p>             sell: share of what you hold, 0 to 100
  --amount <n>              sell: number of tokens
  --all                     sell: everything you hold
  --paper                   buy/sell: play money in this key's paper account, nothing moved
  --slippage <pct>          tolerance in percent, e.g. 3 (default: the platform's)

buy and sell quote first, show the numbers, and ask on a terminal before sending.
--yes skips the question and is for a person to type, never an agent.
A submitted trade is not a filled one: check `positions me` a moment later.
```

## orders

```text
moonrush-cli orders <sub> [options]

  list      Your orders: open (default), closed, or all
  create    A limit, take-profit, stop-loss or trailing order. SPENDS MONEY LATER.
  cancel    Withdraw an open order: --id <uuid>

create:
  --kind limit|tp|sl|trailing-tp|trailing-sl
  --side buy|sell            limit only; tp/sl/trailing are sells
  --address <token>          required
  --networkId <id|name>      solana (default), robinhood, base, bnb, soneium, arc
  --price <usd>              the trigger price, or
  --change <pct>             the trigger as a move from today's price: -20, 50
  --usd <n>                  buy: dollars to spend
  --percent <p>              sell: share of your open position when it fires
  --amount <n>               sell: number of tokens
  --trail <pct>              trailing orders: how far the price may give back
  --slippage <pct>           tolerance in percent (default: the platform's)
  --worse-fill               fill past the slippage band rather than decline
  --expires <days>           1 to 30 (default: the server's)

list: --status open|closed|all  --limit <n>

--paper on create, list or cancel: this API key's paper account instead (play money, real
prices, checked each minute, no confirmation). Paper sells take --percent.

create asks on a terminal before writing the order: once armed it trades by itself.
--yes skips the question and is for a person to type, never an agent.
```

## paper

```text
moonrush-cli paper <sub> [options]

Play money for building and testing an agent: real quotes through the same routes a trade
takes, nothing signed, nothing moved. One account per API key, $1,000 to start, 200 trades a
UTC day.

  status                                   Cash, positions at today's price, results
  buy  --address <token> --usd <n>         A paper buy
  sell --address <token> --percent <p>|--all   A paper sell of what the account holds
  fills [--limit 50]                       Paper trades since the last reset, newest first
  reset                                    Back to $1,000 and nothing held

  --networkId <id|name>   solana (default), base, bnb, robinhood, arc

`trade buy|sell --paper` does the same as paper buy|sell. Standing orders on paper:
`orders create|list|cancel --paper` (limit, tp, sl, trailing; checked each minute).
```

## feed

```text
moonrush-cli feed <sub> [options]

  posts     The feed: mooncalls, reposts and trades, newest first
  user      One person's posts: --username <name> | --userId <uuid>

  --following            posts only: just the people you follow
  --kinds <csv>          comment, repost, trade (default all three)

  --limit <n>            1 to 50 (default 20)
```

## mooncall

```text
moonrush-cli mooncall <sub> [options]

  read      The thread on a position: --positionId <uuid>
  post      Write on a position: --positionId <uuid> --text "<words>". PUBLISHES.
            --parentId <uuid> to reply to a comment instead of posting at the top

  --limit <n>   read: 1 to 50 (default 20)    --cursor <c>   read: the next page

A position's id is the `id` in `positions me`, `positions list` or a feed item.
On your own position a top-level post IS your mooncall; on someone else's it is a reply.
post shows the text and asks on a terminal before publishing.
```

## follow

```text
moonrush-cli follow <sub> [options]

  add       Follow someone: --username <name> | --userId <uuid>
  remove    Unfollow them
  list      Who you follow, or --followers for who follows you
            --username <name> to list someone else's   --limit <n>  --page <n>
```

## agent

```text
moonrush-cli agent <sub> [options]

The Moonrush trading agent: it follows a ranked pool of top traders, buys what
several of them agree on (or copies the wallets you watch), and manages the exit.
Trades Solana, Base, BNB, Robinhood and Arc. Runs on Moonrush's servers.

Building blocks (any key), for the hosted agent or your own:
  rank                  Every trader's record: win rate, profit factor, drawdown, hold
                        time, and bot / lucky / thin / deep_drawdown flags
  traders               The pool the hosted agent follows, with each trader's weight
  activity              "Trader X just bought / sold": the tracked feed
  consensus             Tokens several traders are buying now, your window and bar
  signals               The hosted agent's consensus signals: BUY, and EXIT

Your agents (one flow, one agent: each has its own money, positions, wallet and strategy):
  list                  Every agent of yours: status, mode, equity, PnL, open positions
  create --name <n> [--file f.json]   A new agent, paused on paper, with its own wallet. Its
                        strategy starts from the defaults, or from a flow file.
  rename <id> --name <n>
  delete <id> --yes     Only with no open positions, no USDC in its wallet, not published
  --agent <id|name>     On any command below: which agent. Without it, your first one.

One agent:
  status                Settings, open and closed positions, results, last decisions
  setup                 Create it, or change it. Paper by default. LIVE SPENDS MONEY.
  pause                 No new entries. Exits keep being managed.
  resume                Back to active.
  stop                  Sells everything it holds on its next minute. SELLS.
  watch add|remove|list Watch a Moonrush trader, or ANY Solana / EVM wallet in realtime
  telegram link|status|unlink   Get the agent's messages in Telegram
  key                           The API key in use: its scopes, and for an agent key its limits,
                                what it may still spend today, and its own wallet
  wallet [create]               An agent key's own wallets (Solana + EVM) and their cash; create
                                makes them. Its trades run from these, never your main wallet
  wallet withdraw [--usd <n>]   With the agent key: send its USDC back to your main wallet
                                (all when --usd is left out). Only ever to your main wallet.
  wallet fund --key <keyId> --usd <n>   With a trading key: move USDC from your main wallet
                                into that agent key's wallet. An agent key cannot fund itself.
  notify --text <message>       Send yourself a message in that Telegram (60 an hour), for a
                                runner you built: "bought X", "stopped out of Y"
  sell --position <id>  Sell all of a position, or --pct 25|50|75. SELLS.
  add --position <id> --pct <10|25|50|100>   Buy more of it with that % of your cash.
  token <address> [--chain <c>]   What buying a token would be: figures, filter warnings
  buy <address> --usd <n> [--chain <c>]   Buy a token by address (Solana or EVM). BUYS.
                        Your filters only warn here; the risk check and position limit refuse.
                        --chain: for an EVM address that is a token on several chains.

Templates (the marketplace: rent someone's agent, on paper or live):
  templates             Published agents and their results
  template show <slug>  One: its strategy in words, recent trades, what changed
  template follow <slug> --budget <usd>   Rent it: its strategy, your money. Paper, or live
                        if your agent is (you agree to the creator's fee first).
  template leave        Stop renting: your agent pauses, what it holds keeps its exits
  publish --slug <s> --name <n> [--description <d>] [--fee <pct>]   Publish your agent
                        (reviewed first). --fee: your share of a live renter's profit, 0 to 10.
  publish update [--fee <pct>] [--price <usd> --period once|monthly|free]|unlist|relist|retire
                        Manage what you published. --price: what renting costs on top of
                        the fee, all of it yours; --period free makes it free again.
  template cancel       Stop renewing a monthly rental (it runs to the end of the month paid)

Flows (draw your agent as nodes: triggers, filters, logic, data, Telegram, buy, exits):
  flow schema           Every node, its settings and bounds
  flow list             Your flows, each one an agent's strategy (agentId)
  flow new --name <n> [--file f.json]   New flow, and a paused agent for it (or, with --agent
                        on an agent that has none, that agent's strategy)
  flow get <id> [--out f.json]          A flow: its graph, errors, what it does in words
  flow put <id> --file f.json [--name n] Save; with errors it is kept as a draft
  flow test <id> [--file f.json]        The last 24h of signals through it, node by node
  flow backtest <id> [--days 7|30] [--file f.json]
                                        Past signals through it with a portfolio: trades,
                                        PnL, win rate, drawdown (exits played on candles)
  flow activate <id> | deactivate       --agent runs it, or its own settings again
  flow delete <id>

rank:       --window 7d|30d|90d (30d)  --sort score|pnl|winRate|profitFactor|drawdown
            --min-trades <n> (5)  --exclude bot,lucky,thin,deep_drawdown,bag_holder  --limit <n> (50)
traders:    --limit <n>                      1 to 100 (default 50)
activity:   --trader <@name|id> | --watchlist | --wallet <address> [--networkId <id|name>]
            (default: the pool; --wallet reads any wallet's on-chain buys and sells, with
            "holding": its median buy-to-sell time and whether that is a scalper's,
            under --min-hold <minutes>, default 10)
            --hours <n> (24)  --limit <n> (50)
consensus:  --watchlist  --window <hours> (6)  --min-traders <n> (2)  --min-score <0..1>
signals:    --kind buy|exit  --limit <n>     (default both, 30)
watch:      add|remove --trader <@name|id>
            add|remove --address <sol or 0x wallet> [--label <name>]
              realtime: each buy and sell is pushed (and sent to Telegram) within seconds

setup:
  --mode paper|live          paper books real quotes with no money moving (default)
  --budget <usd>             what it may have at work at once (default 100)
  --per-trade <pct>          largest entry as % of the budget (default 10)
  --max-positions <n>        open at once (default 5)
  --daily-loss <usd>         realized loss in a UTC day that pauses it (default 20)
  --tp <pct>                 take profit, % above entry (default 100)
  --sl <pct>                 stop loss, % below entry (default 30)
  --trail <pct>              trailing stop from the peak (default 25)
  --trail-arm <pct>          gain that arms the trailing stop (default 30)
  --max-hold <hours>         sell after this long (default 72)
  --min-liquidity <usd>      skip thinner pools (default 50000)
  --min-mcap <usd>           skip smaller tokens (default 100000)
  --min-traders <n>          stricter than the shared signal (default 0: use the signal's)
  --slippage <bps|auto>      entries; exits may go wider to get out (default 300; auto: from
                             the token's risk and liquidity, as the app does)
  --no-follow-exits          ignore EXIT signals, keep only TP/SL/trailing/time
  --networks <list>          chains it may trade: solana,base,bnb,robinhood,arc (default all)
  --copy-wallets             also copy the wallets you watch (agent watch add --address):
                             buy when they buy, sell when one you followed sells. Solana
                             and EVM, realtime. --no-copy-wallets turns it off.
  --wallet-min-agree <n>     how many watched wallets must buy the same token (default 1)
  --wallet-window <minutes>  inside how long (default 60)
  --min-wallet-buy <usd>     ignore a watched wallet's buy smaller than this (default 20)
  --max-chase <pct>          skip a copy when the price is already this % above what the
                             wallet paid (default 15)
  --no-mirror-sells          sell everything on a copied wallet's first sale, not its share
  --no-mirror-adds           do not buy more when a copied wallet buys more
  --max-adds <n>             adds per position when mirroring (default 2)
  --add-after <minutes>      no add until the position is this old (default 30, 0 = off)
  --add-below-entry          also add while the price is below the entry (default: only
                             while up). --no-add-below-entry turns it back off.
  --pause-after-losses <n>   pause a wallet after its last n copied trades all lost (default 3,
                             0 = never)
  --sizing conviction|fixed  size a copy by how big the buy is for that wallet (default), or
                             always the largest entry
  --tp-sell <pct>            share sold at the take profit, the rest rides (default 50;
                             100 sells everything)
  --breakeven <pct>          once up this much, a return to the entry sells (default 50; 0 off)
  --min-wallet-hold <min>    skip buys of a wallet whose median hold is under this (default 10;
                             0 off): a scalper is out before a copy is in
  --max-snipers <pct>        skip a token when snipers hold over this % of supply (default 20)
  --max-bundlers <pct>       ... bundlers (default 30)
  --max-dev <pct>            ... the developer (default 20)
  --min-holders <n>          skip a token with fewer holders (default 100)
  --min-age <minutes>        skip a token younger than this (default 30)
                             token filters apply only when Codex knows the figure

templates:  --sort return30d|return7d|renters|newest (return30d)  --limit <n> (20)
            --mode live|paper  --network <id|name>  --q <text>
            returns count every trade at 10% of the account, whatever the creator's budget
template follow: --budget <usd> (required)  --per-trade <pct>  --max-positions <n>  --daily-loss <usd>
            only money settings: the strategy and the watched wallets are the template's.
            An agent that trades live shows the consent, naming the creator's fee, and asks
            on a terminal first (--yes to agree without asking).
            The fee: a share of LIVE profit only, taken in USDC after a winning sale, and only
            on profit above the renter's previous best. Paper renting is free.
publish:    needs a few days of history and closed trades (the server says how many if short);
            listed after Moonrush reviews it

setup in live mode shows the consent text and asks on a terminal first; so do
resume of a live agent, and stop.
--yes skips the question and is for a person to type, never an agent.
```
